headline: Lexar’s Muse is an ultra-slim portable SSD that’s less than 4mm thick
summary: Lexar introduces the Muse, an ultra-slim portable SSD. The drive measures less than 4mm thick, competing for slimmest design. It will launch later this year in 512GB and 1TB capacities.

headline: Aqara goes all in on smart lighting
summary: Aqara unveils a major lineup of new smart lighting products at IFA. Devices are compatible with both Zigbee and Thread smart home standards. New products include the innovative Floor Lamp T1.

headline: RugOne Xsnap 7 Pro: Rugged phone with removable camera
summary: RugOne's Xsnap 7 Pro is a rugged phone with IP68 and IP69K ratings. Its unique feature is one of its three rear cameras being removable. The detachable camera is designed for extreme adventure photography.

headline: Nvidia brings DLSS 5 to older GPUs, but limits user control
summary: Nvidia officially confirms DLSS 5 support for older RTX 40 series GPUs. The AI rendering technology was initially expected only on RTX 50 GPUs. Nvidia will not grant gamers full control over DLSS 5 settings, favoring developer control.

headline: Toei Animation denies involvement in proposed Dragon Ball theme park
summary: A Dragon Ball theme park was announced for the Paris region by France and Saudi Arabia. Toei Animation, the anime producer, officially denied any involvement in the project. The announcement sparked concern in Japan over licensing and representation.

headline: Original Gran Turismo circuit returns after 13 years
summary: Gran Turismo 7's next update will reintroduce the Autumn Ring circuit. This marks the original circuit's return after a 13-year absence. The update also includes new cars and the real-life Sportsland Sugo circuit.

headline: Huge savings on 83" LG Evo M3 4K OLED TV
summary: Get a massive $3,000 discount on the 83" LG Evo M3 4K OLED TV. This 2023 model boasts wireless connectivity. It comes with an extended 5-year warranty.

headline: Samsung Odyssey OLED G5 gaming monitor drops to $269
summary: A 27" Samsung Odyssey OLED G5 gaming monitor is available for $269. This is currently the lowest price for an OLED gaming monitor. The deal includes free shipping.

headline: Senior Reform UK officials resign after undercover report
summary: Two senior Reform UK officials, Dan Jukes and James Orr, have stepped down. Their resignations follow an undercover report. Reform UK has launched an internal investigation into the report.

headline: Nepal flood survivors rescued from tunnel after overcoming immense challenges
summary: Rescuers faced multiple "miraculous" challenges during a Nepal flood rescue. They had to locate a buried tunnel entrance and clear huge rockfalls. All survivors trapped in the tunnel were successfully reached.

headline: Argentine leader threatens oil firms, reasserts Falklands claim
summary: Argentine President Javier Milei threatened to sanction oil companies. He reiterated Argentina's claim over the British Falkland Islands. Milei stated "winds of change" favor their claim to the territory.

headline: Controversial Jackdaw gas field approval imminent
summary: The controversial Jackdaw gas field is expected to be approved in weeks. Government sources indicate the go-ahead is imminent. The gas field is located off the coast of Aberdeen.
